auth.bearer: Open API key (Studio → Developer → API keys)

instructions: Call list_models for the catalog, quote to price a job, generate to run it. Always quote before generating.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List every callable model / workflow with its price in HWT and USD.

kind.description: video | video_edit | audio | image | pipeline | analysis | utility

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Price a generation before running it. Returns the exact HWT that will be deducted.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Submit a generation. Charged up front; returns a job id or a submission hint. Byte-identical submissions within 15 s collapse into one job.

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Current HWT balance of the account that owns the key.
